context: A mom and her young son look for a lost item together
purpose: Teach: しまえ/下さっ/除い/見つから/去っ/あけ/行なう/曰く

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのロボットがどこにも見つからないよ。
lines.en: Mom, my robot can't be found anywhere.
lines.style: Worried young child speaking with rising panic to his mother

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 落ち着いて翔。一緒に探そう。まずおもちゃ箱をあけてみようね。
lines.en: Calm down, Sho. Let's look together. First let's open the toy box, okay?
lines.style: Gentle reassuring mother using a calm soothing voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: もう見たよ!ちゃんと探したもん!もう忘れてしまえばいいや。
lines.en: I already looked! I really searched! Maybe I should just forget about it.
lines.style: Frustrated child whining with a stomping foot energy

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こら、すぐ諦めちゃダメ。ソファの下も覗いてみた？障害物を除いてちゃんと見た？昨日そこで遊んでたでしょう。
lines.en: Hey, don't give up so quickly. Did you peek under the sofa too? Did you move stuff aside and really look? You played there yesterday.
lines.style: Thoughtful mom recalling information with a problem-solving tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 見たよ。あ、お兄ちゃんがさっき公園に行っちゃった。あと、おじいちゃんも家を去っちゃったよね。ロボット、持っていったのかなぁ？
lines.en: I checked. Oh, big brother just went to the park. And grandpa left the house too. Maybe one of them took the robot?
lines.style: Suspicious child with growing alarm in his voice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それはないわよ。お兄ちゃん曰く「弟のおもちゃは触らない」って約束してくれたし、おじいちゃんも「気をつけてね」って言って下さったでしょう？
lines.en: That's not it. Your brother said 'I won't touch my little brother's toys,' and grandpa told you 'be careful,' remember?
lines.style: Warm dependable mother making a reassuring playful explanation

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、そうだった。じゃあ朝になってからまた探したほうがいいかな？
lines.en: Yeah, that's true. Then maybe I should search again once morning comes?
lines.style: Tired child suggesting postponing with hopeful negotiating tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ダメダメ、今ちゃんと捜索を行なうわよ。あ、見て！クッションの後ろ！
lines.en: No way, we'll do a proper search right now. Oh, look! Behind the cushion!
lines.style: Excited triumphant mother making a joyful discovery announcement

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ロボットだ！ママありがとう！もう絶対無くさないよ！
lines.en: It's my robot! Thanks Mom! I'll never lose it again!
lines.style: Overjoyed child shouting with pure relief and happiness
